'''Solaest''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|172|Solaest}}</ref> located in the [[Solaest system/Legends|Solaest system]], a part of the [[Belsmuth sector/Legends|Belsmuth sector]]<ref name="EAOC Solaest" /> in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC Solaest" /> The [[Salin Corridor/Legends|Salin Corridor]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] linked it to the [[Belsmuth system/Legends|Belsmuth]], [[Katraasii system/Legends|Katraasii]], [[New Bornalex system/Legends|New Bornalex]], and [[Shadren system/Legends|Shadren systems]] as well as the [[Phindar system/Legends|Phindar system]]<ref name="TEA" /> of the [[Demetras sector/Legends|Demetras sector]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>

At some point between [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> Solaest was the site of the [[Solaest Uprising]], which was suppressed by the [[Imperial Military/Legends|forces]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="CSWE" /> as part of its wider attempts to crack down on the activities of its enemy during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. The uprising resulted in extensive civilian [[Death/Legends|casualties]].<ref name="TEA" /> Solaest also shared its name with the Imperial [[Solaest Fleet Long Range Patrol Wing]].<ref name="Sourcebook2">[[The Star Wars Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Star Wars Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Solaest was first introduced as part of the name of the Solaest Uprising in ''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]'', a [[1987]] sourcebook authored by [[Bill Slavicsek]] and [[Curtis Smith]] for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Sourcebook1">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref> The [[1998]] ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' by [[Stephen J. Sansweet]] established Solaest as a distinct astronomical object,<ref name="SWE">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> and the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Solaest [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the planet itself, in grid square O-6.<ref name="TEA" />

"[[Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are]]," a [[1990]] [[roleplaying game]] source article published in the [[Voyages SF 13|thirteenth issue]] of the ''[[Voyages SF]]'' magazine, placed Solaest in the [[Fringe Territories]].<ref name="Twinkle">{{VoyagesCite|13|Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are}}</ref> The article is considered [[Canon|noncanonical]] with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="Unlicensed">{{UnlicensedStatus}}</ref>
